recipes.user_request: Complete a batch of coding tasks and return only accepted outputs.
recipes.existing_evidence: Retained Run 3: one-GPU coding replay and evaluator records, not an interactive coding-agent qualification.
recipes.next_test: Ordinary client -> private endpoint -> supplied tests -> bounded repair -> return, cancel and release; check whole allocation bill.
recipes.metric: Time and full-cost per accepted task, including failed attempts and verification.
recipes.authority: Existing runner remains execution owner; lifecycle adapter requires separate authorization.
recipes.reuse: Only matching model/tokenizer/template/cache identity, tenant and request prefix.

recipes.user_request: Turn a permitted document folder into searchable, source-grounded answers.
recipes.existing_evidence: Public components only. No claimed HA retrieval/extraction measurement.
recipes.next_test: Local parse and lexical baseline; freeze relevance judgments; compare remote embedding/reranking only for unresolved work; inject document revisions.
recipes.metric: Extraction field accuracy, retrieval recall/nDCG, citation support and total cost per accepted answer.
recipes.authority: Local preprocessing first; remote input transfer requires explicit data policy.
recipes.reuse: Source digest and parser version invalidate only dependent chunks/index/results; KV identity remains model-specific.

recipes.user_request: Reuse the same permitted long context across related requests.
recipes.existing_evidence: Cache mechanisms are documented upstream; no measured HA cache benefit is claimed.
recipes.next_test: Cold, warm, evicted, changed-prefix, congested worker and different-tenant cases; compare data-transfer cost and actual cache hits.
recipes.metric: Accepted-answer latency and cost with separately measured prefill/decode and retained-cache rent.
recipes.authority: Same tenant and policy; no cross-tenant cache sharing or silent retention.
recipes.reuse: KV cache is not validated answer memory and is not portable across arbitrary runtimes.

recipes.user_request: Run an accepted fluid simulation without replacing the local workstation.
recipes.existing_evidence: External workload lead, not a qualified commercial HA route.
recipes.next_test: Commercial rights first, then matched input grid, convergence/error tolerance, durable checkpoint and release.
recipes.metric: Full cost and wall time to a numerically accepted completed simulation.
recipes.authority: Commercial packaging held until explicit licence rights; no job is dispatched.
recipes.reuse: Mesh/checkpoint identity and solver version, not token or chat history.

boundary: Upstream observations create review work, never automatic installation, provider selection, permission or performance claims.
